mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS id, e.tenant_id AS tenantId, e.objective_id AS objectiveId, e.assignment_id AS assignmentId, e.result_id AS resultId, e.evaluatee_id AS evaluateeId, e.evaluatee_name AS evaluateeName, e.evaluator_id AS evaluatorId, e.evaluator_name AS evaluatorName, e.evaluator_source AS evaluatorSource, e.weight AS weight, e.status AS status, e.invite_time AS inviteTime, e.remind_count AS remindCount, o.objective_name AS objectiveName, o.cycle_name AS cycleName FROM hr_perf_evaluator e LEFT JOIN hr_performance_objective o ON o.id = e.objective_id WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.evaluator_id = #{evaluatorId} AND e.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY e.invite_time DESC, e.id DESC

SELECT e.evaluator_source AS evaluatorSource, e.weight AS weight, r.score AS score FROM hr_perf_evaluator e INNER JOIN hr_perf_evaluator_response r ON r.evaluator_id = e.id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.objective_id = #{objectiveId} AND e.evaluatee_id = #{evaluateeId} AND e.status = 'SUBMITTED'
